glosses: tail (posterior appendage or feathers of some animals)
the part of a dress that is dragged on the floor
tail; empennage (rear structure of an aircraft)

examples.text: Meu cachorro tem a cauda longa.
examples.en: My dog has a long tail.

examples.text: Um peixe nada movendo a cauda.
examples.en: A fish swims by moving its tail.

examples.text: Um gato tem uma cauda e quatro patas.
examples.en: A cat has a tail and four legs.

examples.text: Eu vi a cauda de uma baleia hoje.
examples.en: I saw a whale tail today.

examples.text: Se você cortar a cauda de um lagarto, ela vai crescer de novo.
examples.en: If you cut the tail off of a lizard, it will grow back.
